inn: The courier never reached the crossing. Beneath the inn’s storeroom, a trapdoor leads to the riverbank. Reveal it when the party investigates; removing the roof alone does not reveal the clue.
stable: A borrowed horse returned without its rider. Muddy bootprints lead from the stalls toward the eastern woods. The stablehand heard an argument shortly before dawn.
bridge: The stone bridge is the only dry crossing. Give the party time to scout, measure a route, and decide whether to approach the woods openly. The encounter has no fixed combat outcome.
camp: A screened clearing hides a recently abandoned camp. The courier’s satchel contains an undelivered letter and a charcoal sketch of the inn’s cellar. Reveal the clearing first, then the satchel when it is found.
